title: Knowing Before Answering: Decoding Language Models for Reliable RAG
abstract: arXiv:2608.27661v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieval may provide insufficient or conflicting information needed to answer a question. The system should not only know when to answer but also be able to identify cases in which the documents provided in RAG are insufficient or contain conflicting information. This can be framed as a three-way classification problem, where we use the model's internal signals to determine whether the provided information in the input can be classified as sufficient, insufficient, or conflicting. We create a controlled benchmark dataset that replicates a RAG setup with fictitious information and labels each instance as answerable, insufficient, or conflicting. We use hidden activations and attention-derived features as inputs to train a lightweight linear model to distinguish among the three classes. translated_title: 先知后答：解码语言模型以实现可靠的检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 在检索增强生成（RAG）中，检索到的信息可能不足以回答问题，或包含相互冲突的内容。系统不仅需要知道何时作答，还必须能够识别出RAG所提供文档不充分或存在冲突的情况。这可以被构建为一个三分类问题：我们利用模型的内部信号来判断输入中提供的信息应被归类为充分、不充分还是冲突。我们构建了一个受控的基准数据集，模拟使用虚构信息的RAG场景，并将每个实例标注为可回答、信息不充分或信息冲突三类。我们以隐藏层激活值和基于注意力的特征作为输入，训练一个轻量级线性模型来区分这三个类别。在涵盖不同架构和多种规模的16个语言模型上，我们基于特征的路由器……
tldr: 该论文提出利用语言模型的内部信号（隐藏层激活与注意力特征）训练轻量级线性分类器，在作答前判断RAG检索到的信息是充分、不充分还是冲突，从而提升生成系统的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes training a lightweight linear classifier on language models' internal signals (hidden activations and attention-derived features) to determine whether retrieved RAG context is sufficient, insufficient, or conflicting before answering, thereby improving generation reliability.
